newsitem.title: RUSSIA: ABB unit wins gas turbines project in Russia.
newsitem.headline: ABB unit wins gas turbines project in Russia.

text.p: Swedish-Swiss engineering ABB Group has won a contract valued at around 200 million Swedish crowns ($27.2 million) to supply two gas turbine units to a planned power plant in Russia's Sochi.

A company statement said that ABB Power Generation (Russia), a member of the ABB Group, would supply the units, auxiliary equipment, power plant control system and services for the project, on Russia's Black Sea coast.
"The power plant will be constructed under close cooperation between ABB and Russian power engineering companies," it said.
The gas turbine units will be manufactured in Russia by ABB's joint venture ABB Nevsky, in St Petersburg, where ABB's Russian partner is AO Nevsky Zavod.
ABB has 20 companies in Russia employing around 3000 people in the fields of power generation, power transmission and distribution, industrial and building systems.
The general contractor and owner of the Sochi power plant is the Energo joint-stock company.
